mapper.select: select date_format(e.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(coalesce(s.unit_price, 0)) as contractAmount, sum(case when e.pay_status in ('1', '已支付') then coalesce(s.unit_price, 0) else 0 end) as confirmedAmount from edu_enrollment e inner join edu_course_schedule s on s.schedule_id = e.schedule_id and s.del_flag = '0' where e.del_flag = '0' and e.enrollment_status not in ('2', '已取消') and e.create_time is not null and date_format(e.create_time, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(case when o.order_status <> 'CLOSED' then o.payable_amount else 0 end) as contractAmount, sum(case when o.pay_status = '1' then o.payable_amount - o.refunded_amount else 0 end) as confirmedAmount from edu_material_order o where o.del_flag = '0' and date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month
select salary_month as month, sum(coalesce(total_amount, 0)) as salaryAmount from edu_teacher_salary_record where del_flag = '0' and salary_month between #{begin} and #{end} group by salary_month

select date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') as month, sum(amount) as expenseAmount from edu_finance_expense where del_flag = '0' and date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by month
select expense_type as expenseType, sum(amount) as expenseAmount from edu_finance_expense where del_flag = '0' and date_format(expense_date, '%Y-%m') between #{begin} and #{end} group by expense_type
